about: Few-step adapters a worker can merge into MiniMax-H3, each with the sampling settings its authors recommend. A worker serves one profile for life (serve.py --adapter-profile, deploy env H3_ADAPTER_PROFILE). 'file' is relative to the checkpoint root (the directory holding MiniMax-H3/). 'alpha' is set only for files that embed none; otherwise the loader reads per-layer alpha tensors, then the file's metadata alpha, and FastVideo hybrid files use their rank. 'final_step_size_scale' (default 1) shortens the last step as SMD's sampler does. 'source' is a Hugging Face file (repo, path, revision) or, for a file delivered outside the Hub, 'copy_from': its shared path.

smd-e-8step.description: SMD-H3 E: SMD-MiniMax-H3-T2VA-8step post-trained for visual diversity (smd_h3_div16f_ck3, delivered 2026-11-09); trained for text-to-video, as on songyang's service I2V uses the base model's first-frame conditioning
smd-e-8step.reference: SMD release sampling.json (8 steps, final_step_size_scale 0.5, shifts 12/3) and raw_sigma_grid in its tools/infer_minimax_h3.py; the delivery README: a drop-in for smd_lora.safetensors, rank and alpha 192 in the file metadata, base MiniMax-H3 939557dc (same weights as 42ed227e)
